import java.util.*;

public class MinCostFlow {
    static class Edge {
        int src, dst;
        int cap;
        long cost;
        Edge rev;
        Edge(int s, int d, int c, long co) {
            src = s; dst = d; cap = c; cost = co; rev = null;
        }
    }

    private ArrayList<LinkedList<Edge>> adj;
    private long minCost, totalCost;
    private int[] supp;
    private long[] ptnl;
    private int n;

    public MinCostFlow(int n) {
        this.n = n;
        adj = new ArrayList<>(n);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) adj.add(new LinkedList<>());
        minCost = 0;
        totalCost = 0;
        supp = new int[n];
        ptnl = new long[n];
    }

    // Copy constructor (not used in this program, but kept for completeness)
    public MinCostFlow(MinCostFlow other) {
        this.n = other.n;
        adj = new ArrayList<>(n);
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) adj.add(new LinkedList<>());
        for (int i = 0; i < other.adj.size(); i++) {
            for (Edge e : other.adj.get(i)) {
                if (e.src == i) {
                    addEdge(e.src, e.dst, e.cap, e.cost);
                }
            }
        }
        minCost = other.minCost;
        totalCost = other.totalCost;
        supp = Arrays.copyOf(other.supp, other.supp.length);
        ptnl = Arrays.copyOf(other.ptnl, other.ptnl.length);
    }

    public void addEdge(int src, int dst, int cap, long cost) {
        if (src == dst) return;
        if (cap <= 0) return;
        if (cost < 0) {
            supp[src] -= cap;
            supp[dst] += cap;
            minCost += cap * cost;
            totalCost -= cap * cost;
            Edge fwd = new Edge(dst, src, cap, -cost);
            Edge rev = new Edge(src, dst, 0, cost);
            fwd.rev = rev;
            rev.rev = fwd;
            adj.get(fwd.src).add(fwd);
            adj.get(rev.src).add(rev);
        } else {
            totalCost += cap * cost;
            Edge fwd = new Edge(src, dst, cap, cost);
            Edge rev = new Edge(dst, src, 0, -cost);
            fwd.rev = rev;
            rev.rev = fwd;
            adj.get(fwd.src).add(fwd);
            adj.get(rev.src).add(rev);
        }
    }

    public void supply(int node, int vol) {
        supp[node] += vol;
    }

    private void Dijkstra(Edge[] last) {
        long infty = Long.MAX_VALUE / 2;
        long[] dist = new long[n];
        Arrays.fill(dist, infty);
        PriorityQueue<long[]> pq = new PriorityQueue<>(Comparator.comparingLong(a -> a[0]));
        for (int node = 0; node < n; node++) {
            if (supp[node] > 0) {
                dist[node] = 0;
                pq.offer(new long[]{0, node});
            }
        }
        while (!pq.isEmpty()) {
            long[] top = pq.poll();
            long nsp = top[0];
            int node = (int) top[1];
            if (-nsp != dist[node]) continue;
            ptnl[node] -= nsp;
            if (ptnl[node] > infty) ptnl[node] = infty;
            dist[node] = -1; // invalid
            for (Edge e : adj.get(node)) {
                if (dist[e.dst] == -1 || e.cap == 0) continue;
                long newDist = ptnl[node] + e.cost;
                if (newDist < dist[e.dst] + ptnl[e.dst]) {
                    dist[e.dst] = newDist - ptnl[e.dst];
                    last[e.dst] = e;
                    pq.offer(new long[]{-dist[e.dst], e.dst});
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public boolean flow() {
        boolean aug = true;
        while (aug) {
            aug = false;
            Edge[] last = new Edge[n];
            Dijkstra(last);
            boolean[] shut = new boolean[n];
            for (int dst = 0; dst < n; dst++) {
                if (supp[dst] < 0 && last[dst] != null) {
                    int resid = -supp[dst];
                    int src = dst;
                    int block = -1;
                    while (last[src] != null && !shut[src]) {
                        if (resid >= last[src].cap) {
                            resid = last[src].cap;
                            block = src;
                        }
                        src = last[src].src;
                    }
                    if (shut[src]) block = src;
                    else {
                        if (resid >= supp[src]) {
                            resid = supp[src];
                            block = src;
                        }
                        for (int node = dst; node != src; node = last[node].src) {
                            last[node].cap -= resid;
                            last[node].rev.cap += resid;
                        }
                        supp[src] -= resid;
                        supp[dst] += resid;
                        minCost += ptnl[dst] * resid;
                        aug = true;
                    }
                    if (block >= 0) {
                        for (int node = dst; node != block; node = last[node].src) shut[node] = true;
                        shut[block] = true;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; i++) {
            if (supp[i] > 0) return false;
        }
        return true;
    }

    public long optimal() {
        flow();
        return minCost;
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner sc = new Scanner(System.in);
        int n = sc.nextInt();
        int m = sc.nextInt();
        int k = sc.nextInt();
        int c = sc.nextInt();
        int d = sc.nextInt();
        final int tlim = 105;
        int totalNodes = 6100;
        MinCostFlow mcf = new MinCostFlow(totalNodes);
        for (int i = 0; i < k; i++) {
            int j = sc.nextInt() - 1;
            mcf.supply(j, 1);
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < m; i++) {
            int u = sc.nextInt() - 1;
            int v = sc.nextInt() - 1;
            for (int t = 0; t < tlim; t++) {
                int nu = u + n;
                int nv = v + n;
                for (int x = 0; x < k; x++) {
                    mcf.addEdge(u, nv, 1, c + d * (x * 2 + 1));
                    mcf.addEdge(v, nu, 1, c + d * (x * 2 + 1));
                }
                u = nu;
                v = nv;
            }
        }
        for (int i = 1; i < n; i++) {
            for (int t = 0; t < tlim; t++) {
                mcf.addEdge(n * t + i, n * (t + 1) + i, k, c);
            }
        }
        int dst = mcf.adj.size() - 1;
        mcf.supply(dst, -k);
        for (int t = 0; t <= tlim; t++) {
            mcf.addEdge(t * n, dst, k, 0);
        }
        System.out.println(mcf.optimal());
    }
}
